source.notes: ICSE Class VIII school half-yearly chemistry paper (school not named). Typeset document but the PDF has no usable text layer (only the watermark), so it was OCRed and every line corrected against the page images. Header prints 'Half Yearly Examination 2017-2018', 'Std. : VIII', 'Subject : CHEMISTRY', 'Full Marks : 80', 'Time : 2 Hrs+15mins.' (durationMinutes 135). examYear 2018 is the later year of the printed session (also the file name year). Section A (40 marks, answer all questions, Q1-Q9) and Section B (40 marks, 'Attempt any 4 Questions', Q1-Q6, 10 marks each) both number from Q1, so numbers are stored with a section prefix (A1-A9, B1-B6). Section A questions print only a total per question, so each is kept as one entry with that total; Section B sub-parts A/B/C... carry printed marks and are split. The Section B any-4-of-6 choice cannot be expressed with choiceGroup, so all six questions are included without a choiceGroup: entries add up to 100 against the paper's 80 (40 + 4 x 10). In B3 the fourth part is printed as 'B)' again (stored as 'B (second)'). No answer key is printed.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
